actions.action: Keep the reviewed booking identity fixed
actions.mechanism: Capacity updates change availability, never the selected slot’s identity; selection carries no reservation or availability guarantee.
actions.implementation: Store the selected slot ID and displayed booking details. Confirm that ID through the existing atomic endpoint; require explicit review of changed details.
actions.check: Inject updates before confirmation: verify no different slot is submitted and endpoint rejection leaves the reviewed selection visible.
actions.risk: Review can become stale; clearly label unavailable or changed details.

actions.action: Update availability without moving confirmation controls
actions.mechanism: Stable positions and focus let people reach controls without chasing a layout that changes every five seconds.
actions.implementation: Update availability in place; retain unavailable rows and keyboard focus. At 320 pixels, use a single-column agenda with confirmation in stable document order.
actions.check: During repeated updates, verify focused elements persist, confirmation never moves because rows disappear, and keyboard operation requires no horizontal scrolling.
actions.risk: Frequent announcements overwhelm; announce selected-slot changes politely, not every refresh.

actions.action: Recover with preferences intact and alternatives unselected
actions.mechanism: Separate booking preferences from slot selection so an unavailable slot does not erase the person’s search context.
actions.implementation: After rejection, retain workshop, week, filters, and failed-slot details. Offer matching alternatives with explicit selection and confirmation; explain when no matches remain.
actions.check: Force an endpoint capacity rejection; verify preferences survive, no replacement is preselected, and recovery works by keyboard at 320 pixels.
actions.risk: Alternatives can also disappear; label availability as current, not guaranteed.

actions.action: Measure recovery using input-independent capacity changes
actions.mechanism: Controlled error injection evaluates accessibility without making quick confirmation the route to a better result.
actions.implementation: In tests, reject the first confirmation regardless of elapsed time. Allow untimed recovery; record preference loss, wrong-slot submissions, focus loss, and recovery completion.
actions.check: Repeat with keyboard input and extended pauses: the same rejection must occur, with no automatic substitution or preference reset.
actions.risk: Synthetic rejection misses live-update behavior; separately test five-second updates without scoring speed.
